hook: banal 是陳腐台詞，bane 是禍根，bale 是災禍——道具櫃三格：無聊、禍根、災難。
script: banal＝陳腐老套。bane＝禍因／禍根。bale＝災禍不幸。道具師：台詞無聊≠世界末日；bane of my existence 是禍根，不是 bale 整包棉花。

members.speakLineEn: The movie's banal dialogue made even the chase scenes feel tired.
members.speakLineZh: 這部電影陳腐的對白，連追逐場面都顯得疲乏。

related.synonyms: commonplace, hackneyed, old-hat, shopworn, stock, threadbare

members.speakLineEn: Traffic jams remain the bane of every morning commute into the city.
members.speakLineZh: 塞車仍是每天早上進城通勤的禍根。

members.speakLineEn: Years of war brought bale to families who once farmed the quiet plain.
members.speakLineZh: 連年戰火把痛苦與不幸帶給曾在平靜平原耕作的家庭。

members.speakLineEn: In the folk tale, a jealous neighbor places a curse on the harvest.
members.speakLineZh: 在民間故事裡，嫉妒的鄰居對收成下了詛咒。

members.speakLineEn: The flood became a national disaster within hours of the dam break.
members.speakLineZh: 水壩潰決後數小時內，洪水就變成全國性的災難。

members.speakLineEn: A loud yawn escaped him during the long afternoon lecture.
members.speakLineZh: 冗長的下午講課中，他忍不住打了一個大哈欠。

members.speakLineEn: The gardener loosened the soil around the rose's thick root.
members.speakLineZh: 園丁把玫瑰粗根周圍的土壤鬆開。

members.speakLineEn: Timber beams prop the old roof so it will not collapse in snow.
members.speakLineZh: 木樑支撐著舊屋頂，免得它被積雪壓垮。

members.speakLineEn: She stacked the library books neatly on the middle shelf.
members.speakLineZh: 她把圖書館的書整齊堆在中層架子上。

members.speakLineEn: The two-hour presentation felt boring without a single concrete example.
members.speakLineZh: 兩個小時的簡報沒有任何具體例子，顯得十分無聊。

members.speakLineEn: Many feared the volcanic ash cloud would doom the coastal fishing season.
members.speakLineZh: 許多人擔心火山灰雲會註定沿海漁季的倒霉結局。

pitfalls: bale 也可指大包貨物，語境先分
